title: Mariner 9's "Inca City" ruins near the Martian south pole
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mariner 9's "Inca City" ruins near the Martian south pole, about 1972 at Near the south pole of Mars, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Near the south pole of Mars

tellings.quote: pictures of what looked like ancient ruins these ancient ruins were even in formally dubbed by their team as the Incan City

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1972 Mariner 9, an American space probe orbiting Mars, sent back pictures from near the planet's south pole that looked like ancient ruins. He says the probe's own team informally nicknamed the spot the "Inca City," which, if the shapes were built, would point to a lost civilization on Mars.
